description.value: Skye Avenue Kitchen & Lounge is an upscale restaurant and whisky lounge in Surrey's Central City, established in 2023 and claiming Canada's largest whisky collection with over 1,300 expressions sourced from whisky-producing regions worldwide. The menu is built around modern Canadian cuisine drawing on global influences, and the venue has earned TripAdvisor's Traveller's Choice Award. A touring cyclist stopping here would find an elevated sit-down dining experience with dedicated gluten-free, brunch, happy hour, and high tea menus.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and confirms the business is a real, operating upscale restaurant and whisky lounge in Surrey, BC (not North Vancouver as the OSM community field states). Phone (604-590-0900) and address (13450 102 Ave #190) match between OSM and website. Gluten-free and vegetarian options are confirmed by both OSM tags (diet:gluten_free=yes, diet:vegetarian=yes) and the website's dedicated Gluten-Free menu page. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, takeout, or Wi-Fi mentions appear anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM community field is tagged 'North Vancouver' but the business is located in Surrey, BC per the website title, address, and all contact pages. The GPS coordinates (49.188, -122.849) are consistent with Surrey, not North Vancouver.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating upscale restaurant with an active website, confirmed contact details, and a Traveller's Choice Award. Useful to touring cyclists as a full sit-down dining destination in Surrey's Central City.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website confirms a dedicated Gluten-Free menu ('crafted with care for dietary needs... prepared separate using certified gluten-free ingredients') and vegetarian options appear on the main menu

wow_evidence: Canada's largest whisky collection with over 1,300 expressions
